summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle (math_init.js) — a Bun-compiled blob using shuffled string-array obfuscation (rotator function WV8StW, hex-named _0x... identifiers, decoded via a large constant array n7gIxM). The declared main entry (index.js) is absent from the tarball; the tarball's only functional content is the dropper script and the opaque payload. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute the payload places it outside Node-based inspection at install time. The scope name @ornikar/prismic-components mirrors the Ornikar organization while shipping no legitimate component code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
